name: whey protein
definition: powder of whey protein concentrate, isolate or hydrolysate sold for training or recovery.

name: casein protein
definition: slow-digesting micellar casein powder, usually taken before bed.

name: mass gainer
definition: calorie-dense powder of protein with carbohydrates, sold for gaining weight and muscle.

name: energy gel
definition: pouch of concentrated carbohydrate gel eaten during endurance exercise.

name: hydration drink mix
definition: powder stirred into water for electrolytes and carbohydrate during exercise.

name: hydration drink tablet
definition: effervescent tablet dissolved in water for electrolytes during exercise.

name: adult brief
definition: tab-fastened all-in-one absorbent brief for heavy urinary or bowel leakage.

name: incontinence pad
definition: absorbent pad or liner worn inside underwear for light to moderate leakage, including male guards.

name: protective underwear
definition: pull-on absorbent pants that look like underwear.

name: bed protection pad
definition: flat absorbent or washable pad laid under a person on a bed or chair.
